# Textarea

Multi-line text input (D104): the Input recipe on a native `<textarea>`. Inside a Field, id/aria-describedby/aria-invalid/required are wired as for Input (D49). `minLength` and `maxLength` are the native attributes. With `maxLength`, a counter under the control shows the length; it is not a live region (a count spoken on every keystroke is noise) and joins aria-describedby, so it is read with the field on focus.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | `number` | 3 | no | Visible rows. A textarea's height is its rows; there is no `size`. |
| `minLength` | `number` | — | no | Native minimum length, reported by constraint validation. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | — | no | Native maximum length, enforced while typing. With it, the counter shows `{length} / {maxLength}` unless `showCounter={false}`. |
| `error` | `boolean` | false | no | Show error styling. Inside a Field, the Field's error also lights this. |
| `showCounter` | `boolean` | true | no | With `maxLength`, show the `{length} / {maxLength}` counter under the control. It is not a live region; it describes the textarea. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>` | — | no | Forwarded ref to the underlying `<textarea>` element. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | no | Native placeholder text shown while the field is empty (only on components whose host element supports it). |
| `className` | `string` | — | no | Additional CSS class name(s) merged onto the component's root element. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Tab | A native <textarea>; Enter adds a line, it does not submit the form. |

Inside a Field, id/aria-describedby/aria-invalid/required are wired as for Input (D104). minLength and maxLength are native. With maxLength, a counter under the control shows {length} / {maxLength}; it is not a live region, and it joins aria-describedby so it is read with the field on focus, with a visually hidden "characters".

## Theming

Override `--psi-textarea-*` custom properties at any scope; interactive states derive automatically (L - 0.04 hover, L - 0.08 active).



## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
